How it works

  • Your tool needs to be listed on Ellnow, or approved through Fast-track, before a placement starts.
  • Book with the form above. We confirm the start date by email, then you pay. The placement runs for 30 days and then ends on its own. There's no subscription.
  • Featured links are marked as sponsored, as search engines require for paid links.
  • We don't sell placements to tools on our not-accepted list. If we can't run your placement, you get a full refund.
